tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: App background behind cards and tables: the warm paper ground. Never use for text.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, forms, the main working surfaces.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Table headers, read-only fields, segmented-control tracks, code wells.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, dialogs and drawers (pair with shadow-2 / shadow-3).

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Row and menu-item hover on surface.

tokens.name: surface-selected
tokens.usage: Selected table row, active filter chip, current menu item.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers, card borders, table row rules. Decorative only, never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input, select and checkbox borders. Holds 3:1 on surface and paper in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and figures on paper, surface, surface-sunken and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, descriptions, table meta, axis labels, on every ground above (4.5:1+).

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Placeholders and disabled-adjacent hints on surface only (4.5:1 on surface).

tokens.name: navy-900
tokens.usage: Sidebar and the dark shell: the identity colour.

tokens.name: navy-800
tokens.usage: Sidebar item hover, company switcher, sidebar inputs.

tokens.name: navy-700
tokens.usage: Active sidebar item fill.

tokens.name: navy-line
tokens.usage: Dividers inside the sidebar.

tokens.name: on-navy
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on navy-900, navy-800 and navy-700.

tokens.name: on-navy-muted
tokens.usage: Group labels, secondary nav text and idle icons on navy-900 / navy-800 (4.5:1+).

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, active indicators, focus rings, the revenue series. One primary action per view.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of brand fills.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand and brand-hover fills.

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: Brand-coloured text and links on surface, paper and brand-soft.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted backgrounds: selected chips, brand badges, the debit column wash at low strength.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Brass. The brand mark, draft markers, highlights in charts. Rare: never for actions.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Brass wash behind draft or pinned items.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring with 2px offset on every focusable element. 3:1+ on surface, paper and navy-900.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Profit, credit inflows, up-trends, success text on surface and positive-soft. Always paired with a sign or arrow.

tokens.name: positive-soft
tokens.usage: Success badges and banners.

tokens.name: negative
tokens.usage: Losses, overdue, errors, negative balances on surface and negative-soft. Always paired with parentheses, a minus or an icon.

tokens.name: negative-soft
tokens.usage: Error badges, banners and invalid-field washes.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Due-soon, low stock, unbalanced-voucher text on surface and warning-soft.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Warning badges and banners.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral notices, links to help, tips on surface and info-soft.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Info badges, banners and term-explainer tooltips' icon wells.

tokens.name: debit-wash
tokens.usage: Faint tint behind debit columns in ledgers and vouchers.

tokens.name: credit-wash
tokens.usage: Faint tint behind credit columns in ledgers and vouchers.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: First series: revenue, inflows, the measure the chart is about.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Second series: expenses, outflows, the comparison measure. Calm slate, never red.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Third series or a highlighted point.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Fourth series, previous-period ghosts.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Fifth series and 'other' buckets.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Chart gridlines and the zero baseline at low strength.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Dashboard welcome line and onboarding headers. Once per screen.

styles.name: figure-xl
styles.usage: Headline KPI values in stat tiles. Lining, tabular figures.

styles.name: figure-l
styles.usage: Secondary figures: account balances in summaries, report grand totals.

styles.name: title-sm
styles.usage: Sub-section titles, dialog titles, drawer section heads.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Opening balance carried forward from FY 2025–26.
styles.usage: Default UI text, table cells, form values.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis in tables: party names, subtotal labels.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Meta text, helper text, chart labels. Never for figures.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Table column headers, eyebrows and sidebar group labels, uppercase.

styles.name: amount
styles.usage: Currency cells in tables. Right-aligned; digits are fixed-width.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Account codes, voucher and invoice numbers, keyboard shortcuts.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps inside badges; tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label in buttons; gaps between chips and inline controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell horizontal padding; field label to input.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding (compact); gaps between form fields; mobile page gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding (default).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in the dashboard grid; desktop page gutter.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between page header and content; between major sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Empty-state padding; onboarding sections.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Badges, checkboxes, keyboard hints, chart bars' top corners.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, segmented items, sidebar items.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, popovers and menus.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs, drawers, the command palette.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status pills, avatars, toggle tracks.

tokens.name: shadow-1
tokens.usage: Cards and tables resting on paper. Paired with a line border.

tokens.name: shadow-2
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, tooltips, toasts.

tokens.name: shadow-3
tokens.usage: Dialogs, drawers and the command palette.

layout.note: App-shell measurements. Desktop-first; see README for breakpoints.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Expanded sidebar.

tokens.name: sidebar-compact
tokens.usage: Collapsed, icon-only sidebar (auto below 1200px).

tokens.name: topbar-height
tokens.usage: Top navigation bar.

tokens.name: row-height
tokens.usage: Default table row and control height.

tokens.name: row-compact
tokens.usage: Compact density rows and small controls.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of page content on very wide screens.

tokens.name: bp-sm
tokens.usage: Phone → small tablet: tables become stacked cards.

tokens.name: bp-md
tokens.usage: Tablet: sidebar becomes an overlay drawer.

tokens.name: bp-lg
tokens.usage: Laptop: sidebar auto-collapses to compact.

tokens.name: bp-xl
tokens.usage: Desktop: full dashboard grid.
